definitions.short: Shepham , a place in or near Palestine
definitions.full: H8221. Shepham שְׁפָם proper name, of a location on east border of Israel ; ׳שׁ Num 34:10 , שְׁפָ֫מָה 34:11 ; ᵐ5 Σαπφαμαρ ; site unknown. שֻׁמִּם see שֻׁמִּים below שׁפף .

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
